briefdescription.para: Checks if the functionDeclaration (node) matches functionType.

detaileddescription.para: This is a filter called by solveFunctionPointerCall. It checks that node is a functiondeclaration (or template instantiation) of type functionType. If it does, it is added to a functionList and returned. So function list can have at most 1 entry.

parameterdescription.para: : The node we are checking. It must be an SgFunctionDeclaration

simplesect.para: : If node matched functionType, it is added on functionList and returned. Otherwise functionList is empty.

detaileddescription.para: Add the declaration for functionCallExp to functionList. In the case of function pointers and virtual functions, append the set of declarations to functionList.
